gradeRuling.form: D-005 grade question as posed by the review prompt: is the subject, as bytes, acceptable at application grade (T2-02 application-grade acceptance with no express reservation) as DR-117's preview-scoped design candidate, once the owner lifts D-137's reservation by the owner-controlled entry?
reasons: Bytes would need to change before application. The operative CELL-2 answer, enforcementEvidence.classes, asserts at forty sites that twelve superseded leftover-join versions are current; at application those sentences would be false statements of which sibling joins own the named-gate remainders (B1).

EE-3a asserts a leftover-design obligation, OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING, on a lineage whose current join flags none, and the subject's own basedOn and leftoverDesignOpenStanding say the opposite; a candidate cannot be applied while contradicting itself on which sibling leftovers it leaves untouched (B2).
The self-description of scope understates the second D-293 Decision 5 limb the subject itself performs (SF1); an application-grade artifact's account of what it is must match its bytes.

Everything the ruling does not rest on holds: the seven dispositions, p1p2g3Mapping, the class invariants, inputs, pass rules, owners and gate assignments, the contract.v8 relationship statement, the D-137 reservation handling, the twelve current-version citations in basedOn / joinCurrencyAudit / leftoverDesignOpenStanding, and every digest. The defect is confined to text preview-product-boundary-successor.v8 wrote into the classes and preview-product-boundary-successor.v9 carried unrefreshed.
reservationSweep: Refreshing the forty citation sites and the EE-3a partition and restating the five byte-identity assertions would remove every ground this ruling rests on; a successor carrying those changes is a different byte set and needs its own application-grade review bound to its own digest.
Nothing in this ruling opens D-056 Class A, lifts D-137's reservation, or marks anything SATISFIED; it records a reviewer judgment that the current bytes are not application-grade.
gradeRuling.whatSustainedWouldHaveMeant: A SUSTAINED FOR APPLICATION answer would have recorded only that the bytes need no change before the owner-controlled opening entry; it would not itself have opened Class A or marked DR-117 SATISFIED.
